## Purpose

This is a quality-control / quality-assurance report generated by the Moseley Bioinformatics Lab for the Metabolomics Workbench (MW) analysis {analysis_id} ([link]({analysis_link})) from study {study_id} ([link]({study_link})).
We provide the [Metabolomics Workbench information](#metabolomics-workbench-information) taken from the various MW data blocks, and then various measures of QC/QA that we have found useful to evaluate before analyzing data.

These include:

* [calculating the percent missingness](#missing-values-as-result-of-left-censorship), and whether the missing values are likely due to left-censorship;
* [plotting](#raw-data-boxplot) the raw and median normalized log-abundances in each sample;
* [calculating relative standard deviations (RSD)](#rsd-raw-and-normalized) (also known as coefficient of variation) of features within each group, and comparing raw to normalized values;
* Evaluating the sample grouping by:
  * sample-sample correlations from information-content-informed Kendall-$\tau$ (ICI-Kt),
  * median ICI-Kt within known sample groups, 
  * comparing within factors median ICI-Kt to between factors median ICI-Kt (higher scores are **worse**),
  * factor runs from the hierarchical clustering (higher scores are **worse**),
  * principal component analysis (PCA), 
  * Analaysis of variance (ANOVA) of sample principal component (PC) scores *vs* individual sample factors.
* for these different sets of samples:
  * [all samples](#all-samples);
  * [removing outliers](#outliers-removed);
  * [removing QC samples](#quality-control-samples-removed);
  * [removing both outliers and QC samples](#outliers-and-quality-control-samples-removed)


## Important terms

* Metabolomics Workbench: the data repository where the data came from.
* Project: an overarching question or line of investigation.
* Study: one particular set of analyses. There may be multiple studies in a project.
* Analysis: one run of analysis, such as one type of chromatography, or instrumentation (NMR, MS, specific polarity, LC vs GC, etc). There are one or more analyses per study.
* Sample: one biological unit in an analysis.
* Feature: a measured entity within the instrumentation, within one analysis. This may be a named metabolite, a binned range in NMR, a set of M/Z locations, or a combination of chromatography peak range and M/Z for chromatographic MS.
* NMR: nuclear magnetic resonance.
* MS: mass-spectrometry.
* GC: gas-chromatography.
* LC: liquid-chromatography.

## Overall QC/QA Summary

```{r}
#| label: summary-graphic

summary_data = get_specific_metadata(se_data, "summary")

summary_heatmap
```

::: {.callout-tip title = "Summary Table (click me to see the summary)" collapse = "true"}


```{r}
#| label: tbl-qc-qa-summary
#| tbl-cap: Overall results summary table. The ones used for assigning an overall status are in bold.
summary_table = transform_summary_to_useful_table(summary_data)
bold_status = c("overall_status", setup_statuses(summary_table$original_status))
bold_status_loc = which(summary_table$original_status %in% bold_status)
summary_table |> 
  dplyr::select(-original_status) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_style(style = list(
    gt::cell_text(weight = "bold")
  ),
  locations = gt::cells_body(
    rows = bold_status_loc
  ))
```

## Metabolomics Workbench Information

```{r}
#| label: mwtab-metadata
mwtab_meta = metadata(se_data)$mwtab
```


::: {.panel-tabset}

### Metabolomics Workbench

```{r}

  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
```

### Project

```{r}

  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
```

### Study

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mw-study
#| tbl-cap: Metabolomics workbench study block.
study_info = mwtab_meta$STUDY
if (!is.null(mwtab_meta$RAW_DATA)) {
  study_info = dplyr::bind_rows(
    study_info,
    tibble::tibble(field = "RAW_DATA", value = "Yes")
  )
} else {
  study_info = dplyr::bind_rows(
    study_info,
    tibble::tibble(field = "RAW_DATA", value = "No")
  )
}

if (!is.null(mwtab_meta$DATASOURCE)) {
  study_info = dplyr::bind_rows(
    study_info,
    tibble::tibble(field = "DATASOURCE", value = mwtab_meta$DATASOURCE)
  )
}

study_info |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
```
